manifest.name: dsh-hybrid-notify
manifest.description: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness — in-page toasts, PWA system notifications and browser notifications, with Web Audio synthesized sounds and per-event toggles. dsh-hybrid-notify：DeepSeek Harness 多通道通知插件——按窗口可见性自动切换页面内 toast / PWA 系统通知 / 浏览器通知，附带 Web Audio 合成音效与事件级开关。
manifest.author: johnnren

readme.text: 简体中文 · English

> [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 多通道通知插件 —— 根据窗口可见性自动在页面内 toast、PWA 系统通知、浏览器通知之间切换，并附带 Web Audio 合成音效。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-hybrid-notify)
[](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

---

- **三通道自动选择**，按窗口可见性派发：
  - **页面内 toast** —— 窗口前台且可见时
  - **PWA 系统通知** —— 窗口后台且 PWA 通道可用时
  - **浏览器通知** —— 窗口后台且未注册 Service Worker 时的兜底
- **合成音效** —— Web Audio API 为每种通知级别合成不同音色（成功上行和弦、警告双脉冲等），零音频文件
- **事件级开关** —— 每类事件独立控制：
  - 任务完成
  - 子代理完成
  - 审批请求
  - 用户提问
  - 计划评审请求
  - Agent 出错
  - 后台任务完成
- **通道级开关** —— 分别启停页面内、PWA、浏览器通知
- **会话忽略规则** —— 按会话标题正则屏蔽整套通知（默认忽略 DSH-IM 的 `Telegram ·` 会话）
- **音效设置** —— 总开关、音量滑块、前台播放开关、试听按钮
- **持久通知** —— 重要事件（审批请求、错误）驻留直到手动关闭
- **已读即撤下** —— 会话的未读点消失、或你回到前台查看该会话时，自动撤下通知栏里该会话的系统通知
- **HMR 安全** —— 开发热重载后引擎状态不丢
- **自动播放策略合规** —— 首次用户交互后解锁 AudioContext

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hybrid-notify
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:john-walks-slow/dsh-hybrid-notify

```bash
git clone https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-hybrid-notify.git
cd dsh-hybrid-notify
npm install
node build.mjs

构建产物会部署到 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-hybrid-notify/`。
在 DSH Web UI 打开 **设置 → 通知**。所有设置持久化在 `localStorage`（键 `dsh.notify.config`），改完立即生效。

| 事件 | 默认 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| 任务完成 | 开 | 会话一轮 turn 结束（running → idle） |
| 子代理完成 | 关 | subagent 会话完成 |
| 审批请求 | 开 | Agent 请求批准操作 |
| 用户提问 | 开 | Agent 向你提问 |
| 计划评审请求 | 开 | Plan 模式等待评审 |
| Agent 出错 | 开 | Agent 遇到错误 |
| 后台任务完成 | 关 | 后台 bash 任务结束 |

你当前正在前台查看的会话不会弹出通知。

通知栏里的系统通知会跟随界面状态一起收掉（默认开启，设置 → 通知 → 「已读后清除」可关闭）：

- **未读点消失**：该会话的侧边栏状态点清空——完成点被确认（会话进入主视图，或重新开始运行），或等待授权 / 回答的点被处理掉。
- **回到前台**：窗口重新回到前台，且主视图正显示该会话。

页面内 toast 不受影响——它就在你眼前，会自动消失或点一下关掉。

设置页「忽略会话」一栏，**每行一个正则表达式**；会话标题命中后，该会话既不弹通知也不响铃。

| 默认规则 | 作用 |
|----------|------|
| `^Telegram ·` | 忽略 DSH-IM 的 Telegram 会话 |

- 正则按 JavaScript `RegExp` 语法解析，大小写敏感；写法无效的行会被自动跳过，并在输入框下方提示。
- **清空输入框 = 不忽略任何会话**；「恢复默认」按钮一键还原默认规则。
- 其他 IM 渠道同理，加一行前缀即可，标题格式与 dsh-im 一致：`^微信 ·`、`^飞书 ·`、`^钉钉 ·`、`^企业微信 ·`、`^QQ ·`、`^Slack ·`、`^Discord ·`、`^WhatsApp ·`。

插件用 Web Audio API（振荡器 + 包络整形，无音频文件）为每种通知级别合成独立音色：

| 级别 | 音效 |
|------|------|
| 成功 | 温暖大三和弦上行（C5 → E5 → G5） |
| 错误 | 小调下行（E5 → A4） |
| 警告 | 440 Hz 双脉冲 |
| 信息 | 柔和双音铃（G4 → B4） |

- **通知权限**：PWA 与浏览器通知通道需要浏览器通知权限。首个后台事件到达时会自动请求（仅当权限状态还是 default 时）；设置页每个通道也有 **Grant** 按钮可手动授权。页面内 toast 通道无需任何权限。
- **PWA / Service Worker**：PWA 通道的 Service Worker 由插件宿主端在 `/plugins/dsh-hybrid-notify/sw.js` 提供（作用域 `/plugins/dsh-hybrid-notify/`）。不支持 Service Worker 的环境自动降级为浏览器通知通道，再降级为页面内 toast。
- **音效**：Web Audio API 实时合成，无音频文件下载。受浏览器自动播放策略约束：AudioContext 在你第一次点击/按键时解锁，首次交互前不会有声音。音量可调，另有「前台也播放」开关。
- **零网络访问**：插件不发起任何外部请求、不做任何上报。通知内容全部来自本地 DSH 会话列表快照，Service Worker 脚本由本地 DSH 宿主提供，所有设置仅存于 `localStorage`。
- **兼容性**：需要支持 Notification API 与 Web Audio API 的现代浏览器（Service Worker 可选，仅 PWA 通道需要）。部分移动浏览器对 `new Notification()` 抛异常——这类环境会静默降级为页面内 toast。从源码构建需 Node.js ≥ 18。
- **纯客户端插件**：运行时 `dependencies` 为空；`@deepseek-ai/cordis` 与 `react` 由 DSH 宿主运行时提供（以 `peerDependencies` 声明）。

```
┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐
│   In-page    │    │     PWA      │    │   Browser    │
│   Toast      │    │ Notification │    │ Notification │
│  (foreground)│    │  (background)│    │  (fallback)  │

引擎订阅 DSH 会话列表快照，检测状态迁移（running → idle、待交互），并按窗口可见性把通知派发到合适的通道。

- Node.js 18+
- 任意 DSH profile

```bash
git clone https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-hybrid-notify.git
cd dsh-hybrid-notify
npm install
```

```bash
node build.mjs
```

构建 client bundle 与宿主入口，并部署到 `web` profile 的 `node_modules`。

```bash
npm run typecheck
```

```
src/
├── index.ts                    # 宿主端：SW 路由注册
├── client.ts                   # 客户端插件入口
├── notification-engine.ts      # 核心编排与差分检测
MIT

- [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) —— DSH 插件精选列表
- [dsh-notify-web](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-web) —— 基础通知插件（单通道、无音效）
- 感谢 [LINUX DO](https://linux.do/) 社区提供的交流环境。
简体中文 · English

> Multi-channel notification plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — in-page toasts, PWA system notifications, and browser notifications with synthesized sounds.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-hybrid-notify)
[](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

---

- **Three notification channels**, auto-selected by window visibility:
  - **In-page toast** — when the window is focused and visible
  - **PWA system notification** — when the window is in the background and the PWA channel is available
  - **Browser notification** — fallback when the window is in the background and no Service Worker is registered
- **Synthesized sounds** — Web Audio API tones for each notification severity (chime for success, gentle pulse for warning, etc.), no audio files
- **Granular event toggles** — control each event type independently:
  - Task complete
  - Subagent complete
  - Approval request
  - User question
  - Plan review request
  - Agent error
  - Background job complete
- **Per-channel toggles** — enable/disable in-page, PWA, or browser notifications
- **Session ignore rules** — silence whole sessions by title regex (default: DSH-IM `Telegram ·` sessions)
- **Sound settings** — master toggle, volume slider, foreground playback toggle, test button
- **Persistent notifications** — important events (approval requests, errors) stay visible until dismissed
- **Cleared once read** — a session's system notifications are retracted when its dot is cleared,

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hybrid-notify
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:john-walks-slow/dsh-hybrid-notify

```bash
git clone https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-hybrid-notify.git
cd dsh-hybrid-notify
npm install
node build.mjs

This builds and deploys to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-hybrid-notify/`.
Open **Settings → Notifications** in the DSH Web UI. All settings are persisted to `localStorage` (key `dsh.notify.config`) and take effect immediately.

| Event | Default | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| Task complete | ON | A session's turn finishes (running → idle) |
| Subagent complete | OFF | A subagent session completes |
| Approval request | ON | An agent requests approval |
| User question | ON | An agent asks you a question |
| Plan review request | ON | Plan mode requires your review |
| Agent error | ON | An agent encounters an error |
| Background job complete | OFF | A background bash job finishes |
Notifications are suppressed for the session you are currently viewing in the foreground.

A system notification is retracted together with the UI state it mirrors (on by default; switch it off in Settings → Notifications → *Clear when read*):

- **The dot clears** — the session's sidebar status dot goes away: a completion dot is acknowledged (the session enters the main view, or starts running again), or a pending approval / question dot is resolved.
- **The window comes back** — the window returns to the foreground while the main view already shows that session.
In-page toasts are unaffected — they are right in front of you and either expire or close on click.

The **Ignored sessions** box takes **one regular expression per line**; a session whose title matches gets no notification and no sound.

| Default rule | Effect |
|--------------|--------|
| `^Telegram ·` | Ignore DSH-IM Telegram sessions |

- Patterns are JavaScript `RegExp` sources, case-sensitive. Lines that fail to compile are skipped and reported under the box.
- **Clearing the box ignores nothing**; the *Reset to default* button restores the shipped rule.
- Add one line per channel to silence the rest of dsh-im: `^WeChat ·`, `^Feishu ·`, `^DingTalk ·`, `^WeCom ·`, `^QQ ·`, `^Slack ·`, `^Discord ·`, `^WhatsApp ·`.

The plugin synthesizes distinct tones for each notification level with the Web Audio API (oscillators + envelope shaping, no audio files):

| Level | Sound |
|-------|-------|
| Success | Warm major chord ascending (C5 → E5 → G5) |
| Error | Descending minor interval (E5 → A4) |
| Warning | Two gentle pulses at 440 Hz |
| Info | Soft two-tone chime (G4 → B4) |

- **Notification permission**: the PWA and browser notification channels require browser notification permission. The plugin auto-requests it on the first background event (only when the permission state is still "default"), and each channel has a **Grant** button in Settings. The in-page toast channel needs no permission.
- **PWA / Service Worker**: the PWA channel registers a Service Worker served by the plugin's host half at `/plugins/dsh-hybrid-notify/sw.js` (scope `/plugins/dsh-hybrid-notify/`). Environments without Service Worker support degrade automatically to the browser notification channel, then to in-page toasts.
- **Sounds**: synthesized in real time with the Web Audio API — no audio files to download. Subject to browser autoplay policy: the audio context is unlocked on your first click/keypress, so no sound plays before the first interaction. Configurable volume and an optional "play in foreground" toggle.
- **No network access**: the plugin makes no external requests and reports nothing anywhere. Notification content comes entirely from the local DSH session-list snapshot, the Service Worker script is served by the local DSH host, and all settings stay in `localStora

```
┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐
│   In-page    │    │     PWA      │    │   Browser    │
│   Toast      │    │ Notification │    │ Notification │
│  (foreground)│    │  (background)│    │  (fallback)  │

The engine subscribes to the DSH session list snapshot, detects state transitions (running → idle, pending interactions), and dispatches notifications through the appropriate channel based on window visibility.

- Node.js 18+
- A DSH profile (any)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/john-walks-slow/dsh-hybrid-notify.git
cd dsh-hybrid-notify
npm install
```

```bash
node build.mjs
```

Builds the client bundle and the host entry, then deploys to the `web` profile's `node_modules`.

```bash
npm run typecheck
```

```
src/
├── index.ts                    # Host half: SW route registration
├── client.ts                   # Client plugin entry point
├── notification-engine.ts      # Core orchestrator & diffing
